name: Long March 6C
location_str: LC-9A @ Taiyuan Satellite Launch Center, CHN
slot_a_text: LC-9A has flown 31 launches since its first in 2022, 12 of them this year. Its previous launch was only a day earlier.
slot_b_text: Ion thrusters can produce only about as much thrust as the weight of a sheet of paper, but can run continuously for months or years.
